en.name: Reformulating the Subject of Value Added Tax (VAT) in the Digital Era in Indonesia
en.sinopsis:
This book responds to a fundamental shift in Value Added Tax (VAT) that occurs when supply, payment, customer data, and control over the transaction no longer rest with a single actor. The digital economy does not abolish the principle of VAT as a tax on final consumption; rather, it changes which party is best placed to identify the place of consumption, collect the tax, issue supporting documentation, make corrections, and account for the transaction.

The discussion is directed toward a functional reformulation of the VAT subject, which requires distinguishing between the material supplier, the deemed supplier, the administrative collector, the reporting intermediary, the customer who fulfills its obligations on a self-assessment basis, the jointly and severally liable party, and the consumer as the economic bearer of the tax. These distinctions are intended to prevent gaps, double collection, breaks in the input VAT credit chain, and the imposition of obligations on parties that lack the necessary data or control.

The analysis combines normative legal, comparative, economic, institutional, tax administration, and technological approaches. The experience of the OECD and several other jurisdictions serves as a functional benchmark rather than as a model to be transplanted mechanically. Its ultimate focus remains on the Indonesian context and the principle of legality.

zh.name: 数字化时代印度尼西亚增值税（PPN）纳税主体的重构
zh.sinopsis:
本书旨在回应增值税（PPN）领域的根本性变化：当供应、支付、客户数据与交易控制权不再集中于单一主体时，增值税制度应如何应对。数字经济并未否定增值税作为最终消费税的基本原则，但改变了最有能力识别消费地、征收税款、开具凭证、进行更正并对交易承担责任的主体。

本书的讨论聚焦于从功能角度重构增值税纳税主体，为此需要区分实质供应者、视同供应者、行政代征者、报告中介、自行履行纳税义务的客户、承担连带责任的一方，以及作为经济负担者的消费者。作出上述区分，旨在防止出现征税空白、重复征收、进项税额抵扣链条中断，以及将义务强加于不掌握必要数据或控制权的主体。

本书的分析融合了规范法学、比较法学、经济学、制度分析、税收征管与技术等多种研究路径。经济合作与发展组织（OECD）及其他若干法域的经验被用作功能性参照，而非机械移植的范本。其最终落脚点始终是印度尼西亚的具体国情与税收法定原则。

en.name: Reformulating the Object of Value Added Tax (VAT) in the Digital Era in Indonesia
en.sinopsis:
The digital economy has transformed the way people obtain, use, and pay for economic benefits. Software is no longer necessarily purchased as a copy; content is consumed through subscriptions; computing capacity is acquired on a pay-per-use basis; and platforms bring many parties together within a single chain of transactions. These changes call for a VAT law that remains anchored in the principle of legality yet is able to discern the substance of consumption accurately.

This book examines the reformulation of the VAT object in Indonesia by integrating legal analysis, the economics of consumption taxation, digital business models, tax administration, and international comparison. Its aim is not to expand taxation without limit, but to establish criteria that are neutral, verifiable, and workable, and that safeguard taxpayers’ rights. Readers are offered a framework for assessing the benefit consumed, the place of consumption, the party responsible, and the evidence required.

zh.name: 数字化时代印度尼西亚增值税（PPN）课税对象的重构
zh.sinopsis:
数字经济的发展改变了人们获取、使用经济利益以及为之付费的方式。软件不再总是以拷贝形式购买；内容通过订阅方式消费；计算能力按使用量获取；平台则在同一交易链条中连接众多参与方。这些变化要求增值税法既坚守税收法定原则，又能够准确把握消费的实质。

本书综合运用法学研究、消费课税经济学、数字商业模式、税收征管及国际比较等视角，探讨印度尼西亚增值税（PPN）课税对象的重构。其目的并非无限扩大征税范围，而是构建中立、可证明、可执行且能够保护纳税人权利的判断标准。读者可借此获得一套分析框架，用以判断所消费的利益、消费地、责任主体以及所需证据。

en.name: Reformulating the Value Added Tax (VAT) Mechanism in Addressing the Challenges of Digitalization in Indonesia
en.sinopsis:
Amid the rapid digital transformation taking place across the world, Indonesia is no exception. The digital economy continues to grow swiftly, spanning a wide range of sectors, from e-commerce and fintech to far-reaching platform-based digital businesses. These changes have created an urgent need to reformulate tax mechanisms so that the existing system remains relevant, effective, and capable of accommodating increasingly complex digital transactions. One critical aspect that demands immediate attention is the VAT mechanism, one of the principal sources of state revenue. VAT as applied in the physical world cannot, of course, be applied in its entirety to the digital world without adjustment. Accordingly, this book examines in detail the challenges facing the VAT system in the digital world, as well as the reformulation measures needed to address them.

This book aims to offer a clearer perspective on the dynamics of VAT in Indonesia’s digital era and to put forward concrete recommendations for updating existing tax policies and mechanisms. It is hoped that the book will provide valuable insights for stakeholders—whether in government, business, academia, or the general public—on how we can adapt to developments in the digital economy without sacrificing the principles of fairness and sustainability in tax administration.

zh.name: 应对数字化挑战的印度尼西亚增值税（PPN）机制重构
zh.sinopsis:
当今世界正经历迅猛的数字化转型，印度尼西亚亦不例外。数字经济发展迅速，覆盖电子商务、金融科技以及影响范围极广的数字平台经济等多个领域。这一变化使得重构税收机制成为当务之急，以确保现行制度保持相关性与有效性，并能够适应日益复杂的数字交易。其中亟需关注的一个重要方面是增值税（PPN）机制，因为增值税是国家财政收入的主要来源之一。适用于实体经济的增值税制度，若不加调整，显然无法完全适用于数字领域。因此，本书详细剖析了增值税制度在数字领域所面临的挑战，以及为应对这些挑战所需的机制重构举措。

本书旨在为理解印度尼西亚数字化时代增值税的发展动态提供更为清晰的视角，并就更新现行税收政策与机制提出具体建议。希望本书能够为政府、企业、学术界以及社会公众等各方利益相关者提供有益的见解，帮助我们在不牺牲税收管理中公平与可持续原则的前提下，适应数字经济的发展。

en.name: Principles of Transfer Pricing: Concepts and Application in Indonesia
en.sinopsis:
This book is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of transfer pricing, from its fundamental concepts and the regulatory framework and practices relevant in Indonesia to the applications and analytical steps commonly encountered in developing transfer pricing policies and preparing transfer pricing documentation. We have sought to present the material systematically, with an emphasis on the link between theory and practice. Readers are guided through functional analysis (functions, assets, and risks), the selection of transfer pricing methods, comparability analysis, the selection of comparables, and issues that frequently arise in specific transactions, such as intra-group services, tangible goods, financing, and the use of intangible assets.

Transfer pricing is often a challenging area for many parties—companies, consultants, academics, and tax officials alike—because it brings together economic, accounting, and legal considerations. For this reason, we have designed this book to serve a diverse readership: students who need a conceptual introduction, practitioners who require guidance on application, and researchers seeking an analytical framework and references to deepen their studies. We hope this book will help readers develop a coherent “transfer pricing mindset”: understanding the transaction, assessing the role of each party, selecting the appropriate method, and documenting the process adequately.

zh.name: 转让定价原则：概念及其在印度尼西亚的应用
zh.sinopsis:
本书旨在帮助读者全面理解转让定价，内容涵盖基本概念、印度尼西亚相关的法规框架与实务，以及制定转让定价政策和编制转让定价文档过程中常见的应用与分析步骤。我们力求系统地呈现相关内容，并着重阐明理论与实务之间的联系。读者将循序了解功能分析（功能—资产—风险）、转让定价方法的选择、可比性分析、可比对象的选取，以及集团内劳务、有形货物、融资和无形资产使用等特定交易中经常出现的问题。

转让定价融合了经济、会计与法律等多个层面，因此对于企业、顾问、学者乃至税务机关人员而言，常常是颇具挑战性的领域。为此，本书面向多元读者群体设计：既适用于需要概念性入门的学生，也适用于需要应用指导的实务人士，还可供需要分析框架与参考文献以深化研究的学者使用。我们希望本书能够帮助读者建立条理清晰的“转让定价思维”：理解交易、评估各方所承担的角色、选择恰当的方法，并对整个过程进行充分的文档记录。

en.name: Principles and Concepts of Auditing in Accounting and the Fulfillment of Tax Obligations in Indonesia
en.sinopsis:
This book starts from a simple yet decisive premise: the integrity of numbers is the language of trust. In that language, auditing and taxation do not merely stand side by side; they support each other. Auditing provides assurance on the fairness of financial statements, while taxation, through the self-assessment regime, demands the discipline to calculate, report, and pay tax properly, correctly, completely, and clearly. Where the two meet, the accuracy of numbers is not an intermediate goal but a prerequisite for sound governance, legal certainty, and meaningful economic decisions.

The central thread of this book affirms a strong two-way relationship: the reliability of financial statements is the foundation of accurate tax returns (SPT), while tax readiness serves as a magnifying glass on the quality of accounting processes and internal control. Audit findings may trigger fiscal adjustments. Tax audit results may change the way an entity approaches measurement, recognition, and disclosure.

The book also treats modern practice as an inseparable reality: e-Faktur, e-Bupot, e-Filing, e-Meterai, the integration of the national identity number (NIK) with the Taxpayer ID (NPWP), and the modernization of the Core Tax Administration System together shape a compliance environment that demands high-quality data and a complete audit trail. From sharply focused audit planning, an understanding of the entity and its technology, and the assessment of risks and controls to inspection-ready documentation, readers are shown how good auditing aligns with fiscal reality, so that tax returns reflect economic substance rather than merely the form of transactions.

Intended for students, prospective auditors, accountants, tax practitioners, management, and tax examiners alike, this book helps readers bridge the gap between principle and implementation through a map of the regulations, a risk-based analytical framework, and a practical agenda for building a living tax control framework, a documentation-disciplined incentive strategy, and value-conscious dispute management. Ultimately, the book’s message is clear: build systems, not moments—because value-adding audits and robust tax compliance arise from design, discipline, and documentation that can stand up to scrutiny.

zh.name: 会计与印度尼西亚纳税义务履行中的审计原则与概念
zh.sinopsis:
本书立足于一个简单却至关重要的前提：数字的真实完整是信任的语言。在这一语言中，审计与税务并非仅仅并行，而是相互支撑。审计为财务报表的公允性提供保证；而税务则通过自行申报（self-assessment）制度，要求纳税人以严谨的态度妥善、正确、完整、清晰地计算、申报并缴纳税款。在二者的交汇点上，数字的准确性并非中间目标，而是良好治理、法律确定性以及有价值的经济决策的前提。

本书的主线强调一种紧密的双向关系：财务报表的可靠性是纳税申报表（SPT）准确性的基础，而税务准备状况则如同一面放大镜，映照出会计流程与内部控制的质量。审计发现可能引发纳税调整；税务稽查结果也可能改变企业在计量、确认和披露方面的做法。

本书同样将现代实务视为不可分割的现实：电子税务发票（e-Faktur）、电子扣缴凭证（e-Bupot）、电子申报（e-Filing）、电子印花（e-Meterai）、居民身份号码（NIK）与纳税人识别号（NPWP）的整合，以及核心税务管理系统的现代化，共同塑造了一个对数据质量和完整审计轨迹提出更高要求的合规环境。从精准的审计计划、对被审计单位及其技术环境的了解、风险与控制评估，到可随时接受检查的审计文档，本书引导读者认识良好的审计如何与税务现实相契合，从而使纳税申报表反映经济实质，而非仅仅体现交易形式。

本书面向学生、准审计师、会计人员、税务从业者、管理层以及税务稽查人员，借助法规全景图、基于风险的思维框架以及切实可行的行动议程——包括建立行之有效的税务控制框架、以文档规范为支撑的税收优惠策略，以及具有价值意识的争议管理——帮助读者跨越原则与实施之间的鸿沟。归根结底，本书传达的信息十分明确：构建体系，而非依赖一时，因为有价值的审计与稳健的税务合规，源于经得起问责的设计、纪律与文档。

en.name: The Role of Law in Addressing E-Commerce Tax Challenges in Indonesia
en.sinopsis: In responding to the tax challenges posed by e-commerce, this book discusses and analyzes the existing problems through philosophical, juridical, and paradigmatic inquiry in order to arrive at an ideal legal conception for Indonesia. This inquiry rests on the construction of neo-Kantianism, the four maxims of taxation, and the model of how law operates in society—ideas that extend to the components constituting ideal legal value, namely justice, legal certainty, and public benefit. The results of this philosophical, juridical, and paradigmatic inquiry show that certain provisions are not yet aligned with these components of legal value: justice, legal certainty, and public benefit. These legal and tax concepts yield the components that play a role in addressing e-commerce tax challenges in Indonesia, namely: (a) fairness, neutrality, and equity as components of justice; (b) convenience or ease, efficiency, and flexibility as components of public benefit; and (c) equality before the law, certainty and simplicity, and due process of law as components of legal certainty.

zh.name: 法律在应对印度尼西亚电子商务税收挑战中的作用
zh.sinopsis: 为应对电子商务带来的税收挑战，本书从哲学、法理与范式三个层面对现有问题进行探讨与分析，以期形成适合印度尼西亚的理想法律构想。这一分析以新康德主义思想、税收四原则以及法律在社会中运行的模式为理论基础，其思想延伸至构成理想法律价值的各项要素，即正义、法律确定性与公共效益。哲学、法理与范式层面的研究结果表明，现行法律中仍有部分条款尚未与正义、法律确定性和公共效益这些法律价值构成要素相协调。上述法律与税收概念提炼出在应对印度尼西亚电子商务税收挑战中发挥作用的要素，即：（a）公平（fairness）、中性与衡平（equity），作为构成正义的要素；（b）便利或便捷、效率与灵活性，作为构成公共效益的要素；（c）法律面前人人平等、确定性与简便性，以及正当法律程序，作为构成法律确定性的要素。

en.name: Criminal Law in the Field of Taxation in Indonesia
en.sinopsis: Tax crimes occurring in Indonesia must be handled properly and appropriately so as not to produce multiple adverse effects on society, the relevant stakeholders, the government, and the state. Admittedly, tax crime practices, which are inherently complex and case-specific, can complicate several matters—among them, the fact that consistent sentencing is not always achieved and/or a consistent approach to sentencing in tax matters has yet to be attained, as existing empirical evidence and court decisions demonstrate. Nevertheless, the complexities and problems inherent in tax evasion or tax fraud cannot justify disregarding the legal values that govern the handling of criminal tax cases in Indonesia, given that the ultimate purpose of criminal law is to fulfill the sense of justice.

zh.name: 印度尼西亚税务领域刑法
zh.sinopsis: 发生在印度尼西亚的税务犯罪必须得到妥善、适当的处理，以免对社会、相关利益方、政府和国家造成多重不利影响。诚然，税务犯罪实践本身具有复杂性和个案性，可能在若干方面带来困难，其中包括：量刑未必总能保持一致，和/或税务领域的刑罚适用尚未形成一致的处理路径，现有的实证证据与法院判决均表明了这一事实。然而，逃税（tax evasion）或税务欺诈（tax fraud）所固有的复杂性与问题，不能成为在处理印度尼西亚税务刑事案件时忽视既有法律价值的理由，因为刑法的最终目的在于实现公平正义。

en.name: Corporate Crime and Criminal Liability in the Field of Taxation in Indonesia
en.sinopsis: The intricate and complex nature of tax law and corporate law, sophisticated technology, diverse and modern tax strategies, and the now-commonplace nature of cross-border transactions in today’s digital era present some of the key challenges in enforcing criminal law in taxation against corporate entities. Despite these significant obstacles, the application of corporate criminal law in taxation is essential to promote compliance and fairness. The existing obstacles and challenges must not serve as justification for impeding tax law enforcement against corporate entities that commit tax evasion, tax fraud, and/or other criminal tax offenses.

zh.name: 印度尼西亚税务领域的法人犯罪及其刑事责任
zh.sinopsis: 税法与公司法本身错综复杂，技术日益先进，税务筹划策略多种多样，加之当今数字时代跨境交易已十分普遍，这些都构成了对法人实施税务刑事执法的若干重要挑战。尽管面临重大障碍，但在税务领域对法人适用刑事法律，对于促进税法遵从与公平至关重要。现有的障碍与挑战，不应成为阻碍对实施逃税（tax evasion）、税务欺诈（tax fraud）和/或其他税务犯罪行为的法人进行税务执法的理由。

en.name: Alternative Dispute Resolution in Tax Crimes in Indonesia
en.sinopsis:
This book offers a comprehensive examination of the challenges of law enforcement in Indonesian taxation, particularly in dealing with tax crimes that cause losses to state revenue. Amid the complexity of the self-assessment system and the limitations of conventional litigation, the author proposes the application of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) as a strategic, restorative justice–based approach that is more efficient, fair, and functional.

Drawing on a robust theoretical framework and a comparative study of jurisdictions such as the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia, the book demonstrates that ADR—encompassing mediation, negotiation, conciliation, and arbitration—can serve as a dispute resolution tool oriented not only toward recovering state losses but also toward fostering a culture of voluntary compliance. The author also highlights the urgency of strengthening regulations, institutional reform, training certified mediators, and outreach to taxpayers and law enforcement officials as the foundation for sustainable ADR implementation.

Intended for academics, legal practitioners, policymakers, and tax authorities, this book not only offers conceptual ideas but also charts a concrete roadmap toward a more restorative, adaptive, and humane system of tax justice. In the context of criminal tax law, ADR is no longer seen as a secondary alternative but as a new paradigm of fiscal law enforcement that prioritizes restoration over punishment, dialogue over confrontation, and participation over domination.

zh.name: 印度尼西亚税务犯罪中的替代性争议解决
zh.sinopsis:
本书对印度尼西亚税务领域执法所面临的挑战进行了全面考察，尤其关注损害国家财政收入的税务犯罪的处理。面对自行申报（self-assessment）制度的复杂性以及传统诉讼路径的局限，作者提出引入替代性争议解决（ADR）机制，作为一种以恢复性司法为基础、更具效率、更加公正且更为实用的战略性路径。

本书依托扎实的理论框架，并对美国、英国和澳大利亚等法域进行比较研究，论证了涵盖调解、谈判、和解与仲裁在内的ADR机制可以成为一种争议解决工具，它不仅着眼于弥补国家损失，还有助于培育自愿遵从的文化。作者还强调，加强法规建设、推进机构改革、培训持证调解员，以及面向纳税人和执法人员开展宣传普及，是ADR可持续实施的基础，且具有紧迫性。

本书面向学者、法律从业者、政策制定者以及税务机关，不仅提出了概念性构想，还绘制了一条通往更具恢复性、适应性和人文关怀的税收正义体系的具体路线图。在税务刑法语境下，ADR不再被视为次要的替代选项，而是财税执法的新范式——修复优先于惩罚，对话优先于对抗，参与优先于支配。

en.name: Tax Accounting: Theory and Practice in Indonesia
en.sinopsis:
This book invites readers to view tax accounting not as the task of “filling in tax returns (SPT),” but as an end-to-end system that links day-to-day transactions, bookkeeping, and reconciliation through to tax reporting and the presentation of taxes in the financial statements. Its starting point is simple yet crucial: commercial accounting figures and tax figures often differ not because of “manipulation,” but because the two regimes pursue different objectives—SAK/IFRS seek fair presentation, whereas tax law seeks taxation, legal certainty, and the administration of revenue. This is where tax accounting serves as a bridge: translating accounting profit into taxable income through fiscal reconciliation, while ensuring that current and deferred taxes are adequately presented (PSAK 46/IAS 12), including when uncertainty over income tax treatments arises (ISAK 34/IFRIC 23).

Set against the Indonesian context of a self-assessment system moving toward increasingly data-driven compliance, the book emphasizes that the quality of processes—classification, documentation, traceability, and control—is as important as the resulting figures. Readers are guided in building practical foundations: a chart of accounts (COA) that “speaks tax,” tax tagging for each transaction, tax registers (VAT, withholding slips, tax depreciation, nominative lists), monthly reconciliations, and key controls that make the system preventive rather than reactive. The discussion extends from corporate income tax and deferred tax to VAT, withholding taxes, customs, excise, and stamp duty, as well as Article 21 Income Tax (PPh 21), and closes with an international perspective on tax treaties, BEPS/CbCR, and global developments that demand increasingly granular data. The end result is not merely compliance but defensible tax figures—figures that can be explained as a reasonable business narrative, traced back to supporting evidence, and meaningful to management, auditors, investors, and the public.

zh.name: 税务会计：印度尼西亚的理论与实务
zh.sinopsis:
本书引导读者将税务会计视为一个端到端的系统，而非单纯的“填写纳税申报表（SPT）”工作。这一系统将日常交易、记账、对账，一直延伸至税务申报以及财务报表中的税项列报。本书的出发点简单却关键：商业会计数字与税务数字之所以常常存在差异，并非出于“人为操纵”，而是因为两种制度的目标不同——印尼财务会计准则（SAK）/国际财务报告准则（IFRS）追求公允列报，而税法追求的是课税、法律确定性以及财政收入的征管。正是在这一点上，税务会计发挥着桥梁作用：通过纳税调整将会计利润转化为应纳税所得额，同时确保当期所得税和递延所得税得到恰当列报（PSAK 46/IAS 12），包括在所得税处理存在不确定性的情形下（ISAK 34/IFRIC 23）。

在印度尼西亚实行自行申报（self-assessment）制度、且合规日益走向数据驱动的背景下，本书强调，流程质量——包括分类、文档记录、可追溯性与控制——与最终数字同等重要。本书引导读者搭建实务基础：能够“体现税务信息”的会计科目表（COA）、逐笔交易的税务标记（tax tagging）、各类税务登记簿（增值税、扣缴凭证、税务折旧、费用明细清单）、每月对账，以及使整个体系具有预防性而非被动应对的关键控制措施。内容涵盖法人所得税与递延所得税、增值税（PPN）、预提税、关税/消费税/印花税以及第21条所得税（PPh 21），最后以国际视角探讨税收协定、BEPS/国别报告（CbCR）以及要求数据日益精细化的全球发展动态。其最终成果不仅是合规，更是经得起检验的税务数字——既能作为合理的商业逻辑加以解释，又能追溯至原始凭证，并对管理层、审计师、投资者和公众具有意义。

en.name: Taxation of Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) in Indonesia: Principles and Concepts
en.sinopsis:
Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) are a multidimensional phenomenon situated at the intersection of corporate law, accounting, finance, and, above all, taxation. While M&A is marketed in business terms as an engine of value creation and synergy, from a fiscal perspective it is almost always read as an event involving the transfer of assets and a change of control that may give rise to tax. It is this tension that allows a single transaction to involve numerous stakeholders whose agendas are not always aligned.

This book guides readers through the forms of M&A and the choice of transaction structure (share deal vs. asset deal) to cross-border issues such as tax treaties and beneficial ownership. Here, tax no longer appears as an “additional cost” but as a design variable that can shape the financing structure, the utilization of tax losses, access to book-value facilities, and the management of the target’s historical tax risks. The book simplifies a labyrinth of rules into a logical roadmap: how a single transaction can simultaneously touch on income tax (PPh), VAT, land and building acquisition duty (BPHTB), administrative and enforcement rules, and the international tax treaty regime, and how to read the hierarchy of norms—the Constitution (UUD), Laws (UU), Government Regulations (PP), Minister of Finance Regulations (PMK), and Director General of Taxes Regulations (PER)—when rules appear to conflict. It lays an essential foundation: the principle of legality, the budgetary and regulatory functions of tax (budgetair–regulerend), and the residence and source principles, with tax facilities in restructuring understood as conditional benefits that must be actively secured. Readers are also introduced to a spectrum of key concepts—tax neutrality, tax efficiency, and tax arbitrage—together with the “radar” of substance tests such as substance over form and the business purpose test, as well as the anti-avoidance safeguards (SAAR/GAAR) that increasingly determine the structure of modern M&A. The book further dissects the classic asset deal vs. share deal dilemma—flexibility and a step-up in basis versus an upfront tax burden and administrative complexity—and extends its scope to joint ventures (JVs), including the choice of legal vehicle (PT/PMA vs. KSO), the management of control and related-party relationships, and an understanding of when asset contributions, share swaps, or transfers of functions and risks trigger tax and adjustments.

It is hoped that this book will serve as a guide for practitioners, academics, and executives seeking to design restructurings that make business sense, are legally sound, and are tax-efficient, without resorting to artificial schemes. The book shows that tax is not meant to “kill” M&A, but to ensure that transactions genuinely generate real economic value rather than being mere structural games designed to reduce payments to the state treasury.

zh.name: 印度尼西亚并购（M&A）税务：原则与概念
zh.sinopsis:
并购（Merger & Acquisition，M&A）是一种多维度现象，处于公司法、会计、金融，尤其是税务的交汇点。如果说从商业角度看，并购被视为创造价值与协同效应的引擎，那么从税务角度看，并购几乎总被解读为可能产生纳税义务的资产转让与控制权变更事件。正是这种张力，使得一项交易可能牵涉众多利益相关者，而各方诉求并不总是一致。

本书引导读者了解并购的各种形式、交易结构的选择（股权交易与资产交易），乃至税收协定和受益所有人等跨境问题。在此语境下，税收不再只是“额外成本”，而是一项设计变量，可以影响融资结构、税务亏损的利用、账面价值优惠政策的适用，乃至目标公司历史税务风险的管理。本书将错综复杂的规则化繁为简，梳理成一张逻辑清晰的路线图：一项交易如何同时涉及所得税（PPh）、增值税（PPN）、土地和建筑物权利取得税（BPHTB）、行政与执法规则，乃至国际税收协定制度；以及在规则看似相互冲突时，如何理解规范位阶（宪法、法律、政府条例、财政部长条例、税务总局局长条例，即UUD、UU、PP、PMK、PER）。本书奠定了重要的基础：税收法定原则、税收的财政职能与调节职能（budgetair-regulerend），以及居民管辖与来源地管辖原则；同时指出，重组中的税收优惠是需要积极争取的附条件优惠。读者还将接触到一系列核心概念，包括税收中性、税收效率与税收套利，以及实质重于形式、商业目的测试等实质性审查“雷达”，还有日益决定现代并购结构的反避税防线（SAAR/GAAR）。本书还剖析了资产交易与股权交易之间的经典两难——一边是灵活性与计税基础提升（step-up basis），另一边是前期税负与行政复杂性——并将讨论范围扩展至合资企业（JV），包括法律载体的选择（有限责任公司/外商投资公司（PT/PMA）与联合经营（KSO））、控制权与关联关系的管理，以及何时资产出资、股份互换或功能与风险转移会引发纳税义务和纳税调整。

希望本书能够成为实务人士、学者和企业高管的指南，帮助他们设计出在商业上合理、在法律上稳妥、在税务上高效的重组方案，而不陷入人为安排的陷阱。本书表明，税收并非为了“扼杀”并购，而是为了确保交易真正创造实际经济价值，而不是沦为以减少向国库缴税为目的的结构游戏。
